description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data across six distinct categories, labeled 0 through 5, with each slice representing a proportion of the total dataset. The largest segment, labeled 0, accounts for 27.2% (8006 instances) and is colored light blue. The second largest is segment 2, at 22.4% (6583 instances), shown in light green. Segment 1 follows with 13.8% (4046 instances), depicted in a pale yellow. Segment 3 represents 6.8% (2002 instances) in a light olive green. Segment 4 accounts for 6.2% (1810 instances) in a light blue shade. The smallest segment, 5, makes up 10.4% (3043 instances) and is colored light gray. The chart includes percentage and count labels within each slice, and the segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top, with the largest slice positioned at the top.
